full_feature_corpus.procedure: For each universal-core column and family, exhaustively evaluate every observed single-threshold split in both directions against the one-vs-rest family label; flag the column if the maximum full-corpus F1 is at least the frozen threshold.

unique_scored_tasks.procedure: For each universal-core column and family, exhaustively evaluate every observed single-threshold split in both directions against the one-vs-rest family label; flag the column if the maximum full-corpus F1 is at least the frozen threshold.

procedure: Apply the exhaustive single-threshold one-vs-rest family F1 screen to both the complete 591-row pinned feature corpus and the 202 unique tasks represented in scored metrics-v1.8 primitives, then take the union; outcome values are never read by the detector.
